title: Let's go plogging
text: Liu Tao: What's your plan for the weekend, Su Hai?
Su Hai: I'll go plogging with my family.
Su Hai: It's jogging and picking up rubbish at the same time. It can keep us healthy and make our city clean!
Liu Tao: That sounds great! Can I join you?
Su Hai: Sure! We'll go plogging in the park this Saturday morning. Let's meet at the school gate at nine o'clock.
Liu Tao: OK. I'll be here on time.
